# ffly

> An iPhone app for cheap multi-city trips. You pick the cities you want to see; ffly finds
> the cheapest order and dates to visit them all, favouring sensible flight times over
> pre-dawn wake-ups and midnight landings. Fares come from Ryanair, Wizz Air, airBaltic and
> more, and you book each flight on the airline's own site.

## Pages
- [Home](https://ffly.app/): what the app does, how a search works, Free and ffly Pro.
- [Support](https://ffly.app/support): restoring a purchase, cancelling ffly Pro, why fares
  are indicative, blurred routes on Free, deleting data.
- [Privacy](https://ffly.app/privacy): no account, no location, no IDFA, no ads; what the
  server receives and for how long; anonymous analytics.
- [Terms](https://ffly.app/terms): not a travel agent, indicative fares, the ffly Pro
  auto-renewable subscription terms, Apple's Standard EULA.

## Facts
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17.0 or later. Bundle id ai.overx.ffly. Created by OverX AI (https://overx.ai).
- A search takes a start, up to 3 places to finish and up to 8 cities, each a must or a maybe,
  plus a date window, nights per city and a priority (best schedule, lowest price, or a balance).
- Free: 3 searches, showing the cities, the days in each and the total price.
- ffly Pro: every route in full (dates, flight times, airlines, booking links) and no 3-search
  limit. Weekly and yearly auto-renewable subscriptions, or a one-time Lifetime purchase that does
  not renew. No free trial. Priced in the app.
- No account, no location, no advertising identifier, no ads.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Describe ffly Pro as "every route in full, and no 3-search limit". Pro has a daily fair-use
  search limit, so never describe it as having no limit at all.
- Do not quote a price. Prices are territory-set on the App Store.
- ffly is a search tool, not a travel agent, and is not affiliated with any airline. Fares are
  indicative; the final price is the one on the airline's site.
